description: Windows Dynamic Island overlay with media controls, downloads, notifications, prayer times, and desktop widgets.
notes: REVIEW ONLY — this candidate is not in the active bucket. The latest GitHub release publishes only the NSIS Setup EXE; the repository defines a separate portable build command but does not publish that artifact.
The electron-builder NSIS settings enable runAfterFinish and create per-user desktop and Start Menu shortcuts. Verify the exact silent install and uninstall behavior before promotion.

The app's autoUpdate feature defaults to true. Its updater downloads releases and installs them when the app exits, which can modify Scoop-managed files; resolve or disable this behavior before promotion.
The app stores user data outside the install directory at %APPDATA%\dynamic-nova.
